note.value: The True-Seeker Stone was originally a device used by High Elf Captains to glance into the future. It is now a large black stone that sits upon a bronze cradle in the middle of the deck and drains all the available light into itself, yet helps to guide the Reapers mounted on the vessel.

Restriction: Black Ark Only

A Black Ark with the True-Seeker on board may add one to its dice rolls when it fires its Reapers. Note that in the case of Reapers a roll of one still indicates that it is jammed.
